g.text: Installment loan servicing platform — Processes and Capabilities
One system, every process that uses it and in what role, and the capabilities those processes support. This shows the business impact of changing the system. A
long list against a low criticality rating is worth a second look.

g.title: Bill installment loan and post payments
Assign repossession and send required notices
Remarket recovered collateral and pursue deficiency
Cancel ancillary products and refund unearned premium
